channel.title: NBC Sports Fantasy Football News
channel.description: Latest player news and analysis for fantasy football from NBC Sports.

item.title: Pat Freiermuth (illness) is questionable for Week 10 against the Bengals.
item.description: Freiermuth was added to the injury report Saturday as questionable with an illness. A mid-range TE2 when healthy, Freiermuth’s potential absence likely wouldn’t change much for Darnell Washington’s fantasy outlook. Fantasy managers counting on Freiermuth will need to be proactive about alternative options as the Steelers play the Bengals on Sunday Night Football, which airs on NBC and Peacock.-Nick Shlain

item.title: CBS Sports’ Matt Zenitz reports Omar Cooper (ankle) is expected to play in Week 10 against the Bills.
item.description: Cooper seemed to be trending in the right direction this week as he got in a full practice on Friday. Now he’s expected to play against the Bills, according to Zenitz. Cooper led the Jets in targets last week and will be in the WR3 mix against Buffalo this week.-Nick Shlain

item.title: CBS Sports’ Matt Zenitz reports Adonai Mitchell (knee) is expected to play in Week 10 against the Bills.
item.description: Mitchell remains questionable with a knee injury that put him on the injury report after getting in a full practice Friday. However concerning Mitchell’s new injury seemed, he’s expected to play, according to Zenitz. With Garrett Wilson (concussion) and Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) also expected to play, Mitchell is a boom-or-bust dart throw at best in Week 10.-Nick Shlain

item.title: NFL Insider Jordan Schultz reports Chiefs RB Kenneth Walker (groin) is out for Week 10’s game against the Falcons.
item.description: Walker sat out Friday’s practice with a tight groin and was officially listed as questionable for Week 10’s game against the Falcons. Now Schultz is reporting the 26-year-old running back has been ruled out. Once that becomes official, Emmett Johnson moves into the low-end RB1 mix in a plus matchup against Atlanta.-Nick Shlain

item.title: The Ringer’s Tom Pelissero reports the Saints plan to activate Travis Etienne (hamstring) from injured reserve ahead of Week 10’s game against the Panthers.
item.description: Etienne practiced in full this week and now Pelissero reports he’s in line to return against the Panthers in Week 10. The 27-year-old running back deserves FLEX consideration in a plus matchup against Carolina, though he could be on a snap count in his first game in over a month.-Nick Shlain

item.title: The Ringer’s Tom Pelissero reports Packers RB Josh Jacobs (finger) underwent successful surgery on Friday.
item.description: Jacobs had surgery on his fractured right ring finger Friday in Los Angeles, according to Pelissero. The 28-year-old running back is expected to return in the next few weeks. In the meantime, Kaleb Johnson is the only usable Packers running back for fantasy purposes. He’s an RB3/FLEX play against the Vikings in Week 10.-Nick Shlain

item.title: New Orleans Football’s Mike Triplett reports that the Saints had Jordyn Tyson work with doctors at the University of Wisconsin to address his recurring hamstring issues.
item.description: Tyson has dealt with recurring hamstring injuries since October 2025, and was most recently sidelined by a hamstring strain suffered on August 13th. According to Triplett, the Saints sent Tyson to be evaluated by Dr. Heiderscheit and his team, which received a $4 million research grant from the NFL in 2021 to study hamstring issues, twice during his three-month rehab program. Dr. Heiderscheit successfully treated Packers WR Christian Watson’s recurring hamstring injuries in 2024. According to Triplett, the specialists “determined that something was a little small” in Tyson’s hamstring fascia, which allowed the Saints’ training staff to update Tyson’s exercise regimen with needed alterations. Per Tyson, the changes have allowed the tissue “to fire better.” Given Dr. Heiderscheit’s track record, Tyson’s odds of remaining healthy for the rest of the season are trending upward. He warrants WR3/FLEX treatment at this time.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Seahawks ruled out Leonard Williams (stinger) for Week 10 against the Cardinals.
item.description: The Seahawks’ defense should be fine without him against a Raiders offense now led by rookie QB Fernando Mendoza. The Seahawks will have LB Uchenna Nwosu (ankle) and OG Anthony Bradford (knee) on the field this week, though.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Sione Vaki (ankle) is questionable to play in Week 10 against the Patriots.
item.description: Vaki sat out on Wednesday and Thursday before practicing in a limited capacity on Friday. He remains a worthwhile stash as the Lions’ No. 2 running back. His backup, Jacob Saylors (neck/hamstring), is good to go.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown (ribs) is questionable to play in Week 10 against the Patriots.
item.description: St. Brown was listed as questionable in Week 9 after practicing in a limited capacity all week. He managed to suit up on game day, posting an 8/86 receiving line. He was limited in all three practices this week and once again got hit with the questionable tag. We expect him to play. He should be treated as a WR1, as usual, assuming he is active.-Nic Bodiford
